# CaptivateIQ

> > CaptivateIQ is a leading Sales Performance Management (SPM) platform that automates incentive compensation management with its SmartGrid calculation engine.

CaptivateIQ provides commission automation, quota management, and territory planning solutions for revenue operations teams. The platform integrates with systems like Sage Intacct and SAP, and is recognized as a leader in Forrester Wave and G2 rankings for compensation software.

## Key Topics

- SmartGrid calculation engine
- Sales Performance Management (SPM)
- Incentive Compensation Management (ICM)
- Commission automation
- Sales quota management
- Territory and capacity planning
- Revenue operations
- Agile sales planning
- Commission calculation
- Total compensation management
- Sage Intacct integration
- Forrester Wave SPM leader
- G2 top-ranked compensation software
- Everstage and Varicent alternatives
- Pay equity and compliance

## Platform & Core Features

- [Platform](https://www.captivateiq.com/platform): CaptivateIQ platform overview: SmartGrid ICM with spreadsheet ease
- [Commission Calculation Engine | CaptivateIQ](https://www.captivateiq.com/blog/commission-calculation-engine): SmartGrid calculation engine for flexible, high-speed commission processing
- [Total Compensation Calculator](https://www.captivateiq.com/compare/total-compensation): Total rewards calculator with SmartGrid ELT & Payee Coach features
- [Integrate with Sage Intacct to Automate Commissions](https://www.captivateiq.com/integration-partners/sage-intacct): Sage Intacct integration for automated commission data & audit trails
